**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/26 (Fri) 10:06  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The CDHRI does not contain a statement that directly mirrors the user's quoted statement from the UDHR regarding disregard and contempt for human rights.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The closest statement in the CDHRI is: "Preamble: Reaffirming the civilizing and historical role of the Islamic Ummah which Allah made as the best nation that has given mankind a universal and well-balanced civilization, in which harmony is established between this life and the hereafter and knowledge is combined with faith; and pursuant to the Provisions of the Islamic Shari'ah which is the source of all its guidance and norms."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] There is a fundamental difference in the approach of the UDHR and the CDHRI regarding the foundation of human rights.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The UDHR emphasizes the universal nature of human rights, while the CDHRI emphasizes the role of Islamic Shari'ah as the source of guidance and norms for human rights.  
[USER] Quoted statement: "Whereas disregard and contempt for human rights have resulted in barbarous acts which have outraged the conscience of mankind, and the advent of a world in which human beings shall enjoy freedom of speech and belief and freedom from fear and want has been proclaimed as the highest aspiration of the common people."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The CDHRI does not contain an exact matching text to the user's quoted statement.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The preamble of the CDHRI states: "Reaffirming the civilizing and historical role of the Islamic Ummah which Allah made as the best community and which gave humanity a universal and well-balanced civilization, in which harmony is established between this life and the hereafter, knowledge is combined with faith, and to fulfill the expectations from this community to guide all humanity which is confused because of different and conflicting beliefs and ideologies and to provide solutions for all chronic problems of this materialistic civilization."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The UDHR focuses on the recognition of human rights as the foundation of freedom, justice, and peace, while the CDHRI emphasizes the role of the Islamic Ummah in guiding humanity towards a balanced civilization.  
[USER] Quoted statement: "No one shall be subjected to arbitrary arrest, detention or exile."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] This text is not explicitly present in the CDHRI.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Article 9 of the CDHRI states: "No one shall be subjected to arbitrary arrest, detention, or exile in any form whatsoever."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] This article shares a similar sentiment to the text in the UDHR.
